```sql
WITH ord AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           count(DISTINCT ol.order_id) AS order_count,
           sum(ol.quantity)            AS quantity,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents)    AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT pv.id)       AS variant_count
      FROM ord
      JOIN order_lines ol     ON ol.order_id = ord.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     GROUP BY pv.product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De aggregatie gebeurt nu alleen op `product_id` (de productkolommen zijn functioneel afhankelijk van de primaire sleutel `p.id`), en de join met `products` gebeurt pas op de ~1750 geaggregeerde rijen in plaats van op alle orderregels. Dit vermijdt de grote sort op `(p.id, o.id)` met externe merge naar schijf. Het resultaat blijft gelijk omdat `order_count`, `variant_count`, `quantity` en `revenue_cents` op dezelfde manier worden berekend.
